AlternativeComparisonCard.nbalanceDescription:
Overall N-balance of the region. Inputs consist of N in manure (excreted N by livestock in the region), N as mineral fertilizers and other organic fertilizers. N input via biological fixation varies depending on the Alternative crop allocation.

Outputs are N harvested with crops including crop residues and NH3 losses upon application.

Note: Input values from manure and fertilizers are not linked to the crop allocation model and do not change during optimization. The N balance highlights the current nutrient situation and potential outcomes under the new crop allocation, serving as a basis for discussion on alternative input scenarios.
